dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset contains 334,297 address records for the City of Milwaukee, Wisconsin as of September 18, 2026. It includes address components, mailing information, ZIP code, land-use code, ward, and residential or commercial designation. TAXKEY can be used to join addresses to the City of Milwaukee Parcel Polygons and Master Property File datasets. The source portal states that MAI is updated daily.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
